newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends easier after erratic trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends easier after erratic trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower after an erratic trading day, with an Egyptian tender and talk of a supportive June 1-25 exports aiding sentiment earlier. Lower soyoil prices eased prices at the opening but some covering was found at lower levels. Sept range is between 1,180 and 1,210 ringgit.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Followed the futures with interest against confined to selected oils and nearby CPOs.
"Since there were no leads, people decided to take some profits in the afternoon session," a trader said.
"The earlier market tone was steady in the morning. But price movements were limited as people were waiting for the outcome of the Egyptian tender tonight," a trader said.
Egypt was seeking to buy 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August.
At the close, the September contract closed four ringgit ringgit down at 1,198 ringgit ($474.83) a tonne after trading in the range of 1,195 and 1,208 ringgit
Trading activiy on the futures market picked up in afternoon and turnover was 2,051 lots traded.
Physicals June (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,235 ringgit against bids at 1,230 after trading from 1,240 to 1,232.50.
June (central) saw offers at 1,220 versus 1,212.50 with earlier trades at 1,225 and 1,212.50.
July (south) was offered at 1,235 against bids of 1,230, with trades at 1,240 and 1,232.50. July (central) was offered at 1,220 against bids of 1,212.50 after trading at 1,225 to 1,212.50.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $517.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug/Sept at $515 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $512.50. August was traded at $515.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $560, Aug at $555, Sept at $552.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at 552.50. Aug/Sept was traded at $555.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $400, Aug/Sept at $395 and July/Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290. -- Tan Lee Lee -603- 275-6834 ($1-2.5230)
